prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 78.9%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.5%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 26.3%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Move sign-in after pet adoption', 'Progress notification flow during rendering wait', 'Compact mascot sign-in redesign', 'Waiting screen preview sub-flow', 'Two column path selection screen layout', 'Pet preview style selection new screen in adoption', 'Sign in layout account recovery focus redesign', 'Account pet save status badge redesign on sign-in screen']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Interactive tip carousel on waiting screen', 'Desktop display shortcut hint on final intro screen', 'Stage layout pet companion showcase', 'Desktop controls quick reference hint', 'Desktop sanctuary intro text focus', 'Choose path grid layout redesign', 'Spotlight layout pick friend screen', 'Existing account recovery sign-in headline', 'Desktop preparation wait notification request', 'Desktop tray display hint', 'Desktop tray display shortcut hint', 'Centered photo upload layout with guidance', 'Interactive waiting room mini game sub-flow', 'Reorder sign-in after photo upload step', 'Adoption certificate official seal badge incentive', 'Spotlight layout redesign for final welcome screen', 'Card layout security redesign for sign-in screen', 'Waiting screen live estimated completion timer', 'Desktop companion launchpad redesign for home intro', 'Grid pet selection layout on pick friend screen', 'Desktop ready audio notification on waiting screen', 'Account pet save clarity headline on sign-in', 'Clear path selection intent copy update', 'Desktop setup status preview new flow', 'Custom photo upload formatting hint', 'Home intro checklist layout finish step', 'Full bleed visual layout for home intro screen', 'Desktop pet interaction preview new flow on waiting screen', 'Photo quality and alignment guidance copy in photo upload screen', 'Interactive pet personality teaser new screen in choose path']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Add dedicated desktop controls tutorial screen', 'Preset selection preview flow for custom pet photo upload', 'Account sign-in warning copy for pet sync', 'Split layout for choose path screen', 'Adoption certificate starter accessory badge', 'Delay sign-in until after desktop pet waiting phase', 'Adoption confirmation celebration step', 'Account sync guidance on sign-in buttons', 'Simplified path selection choice cards', 'Starter pet accessories highlight', 'Desktop controls checklist redesign', 'Fast pet creation path headline', 'Adoption certificate mascot highlight', 'Desktop controls interactive quick guide redesign', 'New pet interaction tutorial screen before finish', 'Interactive desktop pet loading status flow', 'Path selection recommendation incentive badge', 'Story screen interactive introduction sub-flow', 'Post adoption certificate sign-in reorder flow', 'Pet personality setup sub-flow during wait', 'Pet habitat environment selection new screen', 'Rendering progress stage checklist for waiting screen', 'Naming pet adoption milestone reward badge', 'Story screen starter companion bonus incentive']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 3 out of 4 tests.
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 5 tests.
Finish hint, adoption layout, and home wait info changes showed no clear effect across all tests of those kinds.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, adoption hint, adoption incentive, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path new_screen, choose_path redesign, finish layout, finish redesign, home notification, home redesign, sign_in copy, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Cloud sync assurance sign in redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen with a full-bleed layout showcasing persistent cloud pet backup and account sync security.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making cloud sync assurance critical at sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Sign in to keep your pet safely saved in the cloud

candidates.title: Welcome story overview new screen
candidates.change: Add a new introductory screen before path selection that introduces the companion pet experience with animated visuals.
candidates.why: 78.9% choose_path conversion with a long mean duration (514s) indicates users need clearer context before choosing a path.

new_welcome_overview.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
new_welcome_overview.body: Choose how you want to create your pet and bring your desktop to life.

candidates.title: Desktop widget placement new flow on home intro
candidates.change: Introduce an interactive widget setup flow on the final welcome screen showing how to dock and un-dock the pet.
candidates.why: Users reported confusion after onboarding regarding how to control or hide the pet (3 emails) and desktop features misbehaving (4 emails).

components.text: Pin pet to desktop taskbar | Drag to reposition | Right-click for options

candidates.title: Two column certificate preview redesign in adoption
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a two-column layout with a live pet certificate frame preview.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 68.5% conversion with 89s median time; a clearer side-by-side design boosts completion confidence.

candidates.title: Photo preparation guide new screen in adoption
candidates.change: Add a dedicated visual preparation guide screen before uploading custom photos to ensure high-quality custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step drops to 68.5%.

new_photo_setup_guide.headline: Tips for the Best Custom Pet Photo
new_photo_setup_guide.body: Use well-lit photos with clear face visibility for best pet rendering results.

candidates.title: Custom pet style upload guidance copy update
candidates.change: Update headline and body text on the pick friend step emphasizing customizable species traits.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.

pick_friend.headline: Choose your companion species and custom style
pick_friend.body: Select a base pet companion style below to ensure proper rendering on your desktop screen.

candidates.title: Background rendering completion system notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop system notifications when pet generation completes while the window is in the background.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s (median 201s), causing drop-off if users navigate away during render.

waiting.hint: We'll notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet render is ready!

candidates.title: Path creation duration hint on choose path
candidates.change: Add an explanatory time duration hint on the choose path options screen comparing preset versus photo routes.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is 514s (median 8s), suggesting decision hesitation for slow users.

choose_path.hint: Quick pick takes ~1 min. Custom photo upload takes ~3 mins.

candidates.title: First week food pouch bonus incentive on finish screen
candidates.change: Display a welcome bonus pet food pouch reward badge on the final onboarding screen.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8%, overall completion only 26.3%, benefiting from a finishing reward.

candidates.title: Step by step pet generation wait info status
candidates.change: Display detailed generation progress steps with step counter and active process indicator during waiting.
candidates.why: Home step waiting time has a high mean (2336s), leaving users unsure of background activity.
